items.title: Withdraw from the electricity contract (Widerruf)
items.quote: Sie haben das Recht, binnen vierzehn Tagen ab Vertragsschluss ohne Angabe von Gründen von diesem Vertrag zurückzutreten, indem Sie ihn widerrufen.
items.computation: Anchor is the stated date of contract conclusion, 20.11.2026 (Friday), which the letter itself treats as the start of the 14-day period. Under § 187 Abs. 1 BGB the day of the event (20.11.) is not counted, so counting starts 21.11.2026. 14 days later lands on 04.12.2026 (Friday). That day is a normal working day in NW (no weekend/holiday clash), so under § 193 BGB no shift is needed. For a Widerruf it is enough that the declaration is sent (not received) by the deadline, per § 355 Abs. 1 BGB.

warnings: This is a door-to-door sale ('Gespräch an Ihrer Haustür') — such contracts are a common setting for high-pressure sales tactics; make sure the switch to this supplier was really wanted before letting the 14-day withdrawal deadline pass.

The sender's email domain printed on the letter (kundenservice@exempelenergie.example) is a placeholder/example-style domain, not a real company domain — if this is meant to be a genuine letter, double-check the real sender's contact details before relying on them.

The tariff name 'Rhein Strom fix 24' suggests a 24-month fixed term, but the letter does not state the actual current_term_end date or the cancellation deadline for that term — check the full contract/AGB for these dates; none could be computed from this letter alone.

The letter states the 14-day withdrawal period runs 'ab Vertragsschluss' (from signing); by law for a Haustürgeschäft the period can start later if the trader did not hand over complete withdrawal information and a copy of the contract — if that documentation was incomplete, the real deadline could be later than 04.12.2026.
